what: PayPal processes digital payments. It runs the PayPal checkout button used by hundreds of millions of consumers, the Venmo app in the United States, and Braintree, which handles payments behind the scenes for large online merchants.
customers: Online shoppers, merchants of all sizes, and large platforms using Braintree's payment processing.
money: fees on payments processed through PayPal, Venmo and Braintree
credit products, interest on balances and merchant services
moat: A two-sided network of 439 million accounts and millions of merchants, where consumers trust a checkout that does not share their card details.
risks: Braintree processes large volumes at very thin margins, which dilutes profitability
Apple Pay and Shop Pay compete directly at checkout
Analyst targets imply the shares are roughly fairly valued
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 15% with an 18% operating margin
Venmo is being monetised through debit cards and merchant checkout
Large buybacks shrink the share count each year
watch: Branded checkout volume growth and transaction margin dollars.
